verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Pika serves an llms.txt at https://pika.art/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured product summary. The file lists apps, models, pricing, the Pika API and Pika MCP connection info, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Missing for 10: evidence of deeper agent-oriented docs (e.g., an llms-full.txt or markdown API/MCP reference), and independent reports of agents using it successfully.
